notes.title: Its Time To Meet God Demo Update 1.0.8
notes.notes: Implemented base ENEMY TRACKER UI to help players better understand what is and is not an enemy.

notes.title: Its Time To Meet God Demo Update 1.0.7
notes.notes: Implemented Hit Scanner and Hit Indicator system for projectiles and collision based enemies to allow the player to have better understanding of where they are being hit from.

notes.title: Its Time To Meet God Demo Update 1.0.6
notes.notes: Implemented Placeholder Image Objects for tutorial to better explain objectives and enemy types

notes.title: Its Time To Meet God Demo Update 1.0.5
notes.notes:
Angelic Hosts now spawn lower beneath the ceiling tiles to better display the location of the

next gateway

Double Eyed Ophanim changed to no longer reflect the random color seed for better visibility

notes.title: Its Time To Meet God Demo Update 1.0.4
notes.notes:
Ensured Ammo Counter Only Displays "NO AMMO" read when weapons that require 

ammo are equipped

Fixed an issue with sprites from shops not rendering correctly



What's next?:  

The following are features that are not yet implemented and are a concept in design.

- Attempting to rework a Color coded mode into the game that allows the player to choose

1. The color of enemies

2. The color of items

3 the color of projectiles

4 the color of chests

5 the color of doorways



To allow the player to better understand what they are looking at

This mode will be optional but will not effect any gameplay rewards.

notes.title: Its Time To Meet God Demo Update 1.0.3
notes.notes:
Ensured Item Descriptions Read Correctly

Some Sprite Resolutions changed 

Lowered Ophanic Sentinel Spawn Rate 

Improved and Revamped Inventory System

Increased player Starting Speed

Decreased Boots Of Gospel Speed Increase by 1.5 


-The Player now becomes frozen upon inventory open in order to allow mouse selection and description viewing

notes.title: Its Time To Meet God Demo Update 1.0.2
notes.notes:
Added Button for Closing all shop windows
 
Fixed bug where player would die and shop window continued to render

Added extra tutorial notifiers

Added Ability to use scroll wheel to change sensitivity

Fixed Sensitivity not functioning in options menu.

  - This update is primarily related to the Demo Build of Its Time To Meet God -
